leadIn.title: Lead-In & Context: There is / There are
leadIn.content: Describing what exists in a place: There is a computer on the desk, and there are three books next to it.

meaningCheck.question: Function check: What is the primary purpose of using There is / There are?
options: To express clear, level-appropriate meaning in structured context
To translate sentences word-for-word from another language
It is an obsolete form never used by native speakers
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · This structure provides explicit grammatical function and clarity.

meaningCheck.question: Form check: Does correct usage of There is / There are require matching subject, verb, and modifier agreements?
options: No, agreement rules are optional in English
Yes, matching grammatical forms ensures natural, accurate communication
Agreement only matters in formal academic writing
meaningCheck.explanation: Correct · Accurate form and agreement choices prevent misunderstandings.

form.title: Form & Structure: There is / There are
form.content: There is + singular noun / uncountable noun. There are + plural noun. Negative: There isn't / There aren't. Question: Is there...? / Are there...?

controlledPractice.question: 'There ___ two dogs in the garden.'
controlledPractice.explanation: Two dogs is plural, so it takes 'are'.
